ModMetaData.name: GlyphFix
ModMetaData.author: SleepSheep
ModMetaData.description: Repairs three rendering defects of the Waylith Android port: blank build-menu icons (uiIcon resolved to BadTex through an unrenderable CutoutComplexUI material), the empty gizmo box beside Draft (Misc/GrayscaleGUI is not registered in this port, so disabled-command icons were drawn through the default shader), and the blank icon of a modified weapon (Odyssey: the instance graphic yields no drawable texture, so the icon falls back to def.uiIcon, then to def.graphic). Steady-state cost 16.7 ns per patched call.
